subject: Graduate program expression of interest: civil engineering, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Dear Mr White,

I am registering my interest in the Adams graduate program through your careers page and wanted your civil team to see it as well. This is a speculative enquiry, as no position is advertised right now.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019), and from 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for office, site and regional work.

Your graduate program pairs graduates with experienced engineers from concept design through construction stages, which is the kind of start I want. My drafting experience is from study rather than a paid role.

If a graduate or junior civil position opens, I would value a short conversation. I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

paragraphs: I am registering my interest in your graduate program through the Adams careers page. The page says recent civil and structural graduates gain experience from concept design through construction stages with guidance from experienced engineers, and that is the start I am looking for.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D using Australian Standards, and lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries to design around existing services. This is coursework rather than commercial drafting.

Before moving to Australia I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering and worked on site in the Philippines from 2019 to 2020 as a project-in-charge engineer and field engineer. I coordinated daily crews, reviewed structural and architectural drawings against project requirements, carried out inspections and quality checks, and kept site reports and material records.

I live in Melton and can reach your Bourke Street or Geelong office. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I do not have Australian consulting experience yet, so the mentoring your program offers matters to me.
If a graduate or junior civil position opens in your civil team, I would value the chance to talk. I've attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
